note: Independent audit against RFC 8671 Section 5.2 ('All mandatory attributes, such as next hop, MUST be either zero or have an empty length if they are unknown at the pre-policy phase completion.'). Production code normalizes pre-policy Adj-RIB-Out announcements in normalizePrePolicyAdjRIBOutBody (invoked both on the live handleSenderPrePolicyOut path and on cacheAdjUpdate before snapshot caching): missing ORIGIN (code 1) and AS_PATH (code 2) are emitted with empty length 0; missing, non-4-byte, or nextHopUnknown IPv4 NEXT_HOP (code 3) for inline NLRI is encoded as 0.0.0.0 (4 zero octets); MP_REACH_NLRI (code 14) with nextHopUnknown encodes Next Hop Network Address Length as 0 (empty length) via appendMPReachEmptyNextHop while preserving AFI/SAFI, reserved=0, and NLRI verbatim; withdrawal-only and End-of-RIB UPDATEs are returned unchanged. In the reactor, emitPrePolicyAdjRIBOut marks PrePolicyNextHopUnknown when transmission-time next-hop rewriting applies (nhSelfWithheld or nhMode != nhModeNone) or when an injected body already carries an unknown/zero next hop. Positive test TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutNormalizesUnknownMandatoryAttrs drives the live BMP sender pipe and replay primeSender across four subtests covering unknown IPv4 NEXT_HOP zeroing to 0.0.0.0 (preserving known ORIGIN/AS_PATH/NLRI), missing ORIGIN/AS_PATH/NEXT_HOP synthesis as empty/zero, unknown IPv6 MP_REACH_NLRI next hop encoded with empty length 0, and replayed snapshot normalization. Negative test TestRFC8671PrePolicyAdjRIBOutPreservesKnownMandatoryAttrsAndWithdrawals proves known IPv4 and IPv6 mandatory attributes are conveyed byte-for-byte verbatim when nextHopUnknown is false and withdrawal-only UPDATEs gain no fabricated mandatory attributes. Discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc8671/RFC8671-5.2-2.json prove whole-producer dependency on normalizePrePolicyAdjRIBOutBody; source inspection confirms exact byte/length discrimination across all subtests.
